0: LOCAL ORDINANCE 99-18 AMENDMENT TO YARD SALE ORDINANCE An Ordinance to amend the existing Town of Pine Mountain Yard Sale Ordinance to provide fines for violations; to provide for the issuance of permits for yard and garage sales; to provide an effective date to repeal all ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith; and for other purposes. WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain adopted a comprehensive ordinance to regulate yard and garage sales, which was signed into law on August 14, 2023, (the “Ordinance”); and WHEREAS, the Mayor and Council of the Town of Pine Mountain desire to provide fines for violations of the Ordinance; and WHEREAS, individuals or businesses desiring to shall be required to obtain a permit from the Town Clerk; and WHEREAS, the Town of Pine Mountain desires to amend the Ordinance to adopt and implement such permitting procedure. NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, HARRIS COUNTY, GEORGIA, AND BY AUTHORITY OF THE SAME, IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED AS FOLLOWS:
1: That Section 1 of the Ordinance is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following is inserted in lieu thereof:

It shall not be the intention of this Ordinance to prohibit the occasional sale of personal belongings on one’s property subject to the following: (a) At least five (5) business days prior to the proposed sale, a property owner shall apply to the Town Clerk for a permit by providing the following documents to the Town Clerk: (i) a fully completed and signed Yard or Garage Sale Application, forms of which shall be kept on file by the Town Clerk;

- (ii) a permit fee of $10, provided that such fee shall be waived for the first application made by an applicant in each calendar year; and (iii) such other evidence as the Town Clerk may require in his or her reasonable discretion. (b) Each yard or garage sale shall be limited to one three (3) day period. (c) Yard or garage sales shall not occur on any property more often than four (4) times per calendar year, and no applicant for a permit shall be eligible to obtain more than four (4) permits (regardless of property location) per calendar year. (d) It shall be a violation of this ordinance to sell, offer for sale, or display for sale merchandise in any yard, carport, garage or house that is not the personal property of the occupants of the property. (e) This Ordinance shall not regulate the private sale of major personal property possessions, such as homes, boats and personal automobiles. (f) Violations of this ordinance shall be punishable as follows: (i) 1 st Violation: $75 fine (ii) 2 nd Violation in a calendar year: $150 fine (ii) All subsequent Violations in a calendar year: $250 fine
3: All ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby expressly repealed.
